review_candidates.title: Network Security Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Description: Network Security Administrator Role Summary We are seeking a Network Security Administrator to manage and maintain our multi-vendor security infrastructure. You will be responsible for the day-to-day administration, tuning, and lifecycle management of firewalls, application delivery and WAF platforms, DDoS protection, and email security solutions, ensuring they are secure, stable, and well integrated. Key Responsibilities Security Platform Administration Perform end-to-end admin
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Required Qualifications 3 to 4 years of relevant experience in network security, cybersecurity operations, or security administration. Hands-on experience administering multiple security tools, including: Firewalls: Cisco Firepower, Palo Alto WAF/VPN/DNS: F5 (ASM, APM, GTM) DDoS protection: Arbor, Akamai Email security: Proofpoint, Symantec, Cisco ESA, FortiMail Strong understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, routing, and switching. Preferred Qualifications Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell or Python.
